item.title: DNA recovered from glove found near Guthrie home that appears to match glove worn by suspect, FBI says
item.description: The FBI says a glove containing DNA was found about two miles from Nancy Guthrie's house and appears to match those worn by a masked person seen outside her front door.

item.title: : EditorialWe must protect Pennsylvania’s young people from chatbots
